g.text: Search progress over measured wall time | Full runs
All five modes, every seed | Logarithmic time axis | Each curve stops at its own measured search endpoint
Endpoints are different time budgets. Compare at a shared time only where runs are still observed; no claim is made beyond a stopped run.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: Search time includes cold start and final evaluation; process-only import, export and post-search audit are reported separately.
